children: Shares of Corning advanced Tuesday after Verizon Communications announced a supply agreement with the optical networking company for broadband expansion and next-generation artificial-intelligence infrastructure.
Corning stock rose 3.6% to $159.90 in premarket trading on Tuesday while Verizon stock declined 0.7% to $49.78.

Verizon said Tuesday the multi-billion dollar supply agreement runs through 2032. Corning will supply "high-capacity" optical solutions to "expand nationwide consumer broadband access" and support generative AI compute needs.
